pageCache.text:
Welcome to our school
At Marsh Gibbon our vision drives everything that we do. ​Succeeding together - fostering a love of learning, within a nurturing Christian community, to bring out‘the best in everyone’. We want pupils to:Love learningCare for others within their community in the way that they themselves would like to be treatedTo be the best that they can be so that they can succeedAs a Church School we use the bible verse from Philippians 4 verse 13 to guide us and underpin everything that we do.​It reminds us to always persevere. “I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me” Philippians 4:13​Our catchment area covers the village of Marsh Gibbon and the surrounding area.If you are a prospective parent, we would encourage you to see our school for yourself.​ Please contact the school office to make an appointment​on 01869 277268; we would love to meet you and show you around.Mrs Beth Brown Headteacher Marsh Gibbon SchoolCastle StreetMarsh GibbonOxfordshireOX27 0HJ​01869 277 268Contact the school administrator for all enquiries: Mrs Jess Wallace ​[email protected]
